newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste CEO reassures on 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Neste CEO reassures on 1996 dividend.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said on Friday its equity would be sufficient to pay a dividend this year, despite a 26 million markka surprise loss in January-August.

"As far as the possibility of paying a dividend is concerned ... the unrestricted equity of Neste's parent company is amply sufficient for a dividend payment. There's no doubt about it," Neste CEO Jaakko Ihamuotila told a news conference.
"History shows that even in loss-making years, Neste has paid a dividend," Ihamuotila added.
Neste earlier said it would make a profit for the full year 1996 despite plunging to a 26 million markka January-August loss from a 1.14 billion profit in the year-ago period.
